name: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features (arXiv:2304.07193)
notes: TMLR 2023. DINOv2-L (large) has ~304M parameters. At 224x224, DINOv2-L costs ~17.5 GFLOPs per image (same ViT-L/14 architecture as CLIP). DINOv2 is used as a vision encoder in some production systems but is less common as a VLM vision tower than CLIP/SigLIP.
